283737327.description: This vintage collection includes seven small clear specimen containers, each holding a different mineral or rock sample in colors such as clear, amber, green, brown, and yellow. The containers and lids show signs of age and dust accumulation, suggesting long-term storage. Additionally, there is one larger loose mineral specimen that is rough, translucent, and light pink in color, possibly rose quartz. No brand or manufacturer markings are visible on any of the items.

283686091.description: This lot features a variety of fossils including coprolite, dinosaur bone fragments, crinoids, gastropods, coral, orthocereas, brachiopods, sea urchins, clams, and stromatolites. It also includes resin-embedded specimens such as an insect and a seahorse, along with some unidentified fossil fragments. Each specimen comes with a descriptive card for identification. The fossils are in generally good condition and are individually labeled for easy reference.

283781335.description:
Artist Unknown
Standing Man with Pipe and Sickle
Hand-Carved Solid Wood Sculpture
28" x 5" x 5"
Unsigned
This striking figurative wood carving reflects traditional African folk art sculpture, carved from a single piece of solid hardwood. The tall, elongated composition depicts a standing male figure smoking a long pipe while holding a curved sickle or tapping knife, with a textured cross-body pouch draped over his right shoulder. The artisan has rendered expressive facial contours, prominent eyes, textured hair, and incised hatching along the shirt and pouch, set atop an integral cylindrical base.
Carved from a single log of natural wood with visible tool marks and grain patterns
Detailed relief carving on the woven-style pouch and rolled pant leg cuff
Traditional folk art representation of agrarian harvest or palm wine tapping
Condition:
Very good vintage condition with an attractive aged wood patina. Features natural age checks, wood grain separations, and minor surface wear consistent with age and hand craftsmanship. Structurally sound and stands firmly upright.

283901862.description:
Natural Specimen & Lapidary Carving Collection
Mixed Mineral, Fossil, and Shell Lot
Quartz Crystal, Fossiliferous Stone, Pearlized Shell, 7 Pieces
This seven-piece natural history and lapidary lot features an attractive mix of geologic formations, polished marine life, and carved fossil stone. The collection includes five natural quartz crystal geode halves showcasing sparkling druse interiors, an iridescent pearlized Trochus top shell, and a polished Moroccan-style fossil stone stingray carving embedded with prehistoric marine inclusions.
5 natural quartz geode halves with exposed white crystalline drusy interiors and rough tan matrix
1 polished mother-of-pearl Trochus sea shell with shimmering nacre and spiral whorl
1 polished carved fossil limestone stingray figure showing fossilized cephalopod inclusions, fitted with a small stone riser block on the underside
Suitable for cabinet display, specimen study, or decorative lapidary arrangements
Condition:
All specimens are in very good display condition. Quartz geode halves retain clean crystal faces with natural rough exterior edges. Pearlized shell shows clean spiral form with smooth polished finish and minimal handling wear. Carved fossil stone stingray is intact with a high-gloss polished top surface, intact tail tip, and securely affixed stone support block underneath.
